gaps.normative_requirement: Compliance with ISO 2768-1 can only be confirmed against the text of that standard.
gaps.finding_reason: The report states testing to ISO 2768-1, but ISO 2768-1 was not supplied for this review, so its requirements were not evaluated.
gaps.required_action: Upload ISO 2768-1 and re-run the evaluation, or confirm it is outside the certification scope.

gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant compliance tests are carried out on the specified sample or permitted separate samples.
gaps.finding_reason: The report refers to several appended result tables that are not present in the supplied 45-page report; PDF page 44 also repeats printed page number 43. The integrity and completeness of the test record cannot be established.
gaps.required_action: Obtain the complete, correctly paginated laboratory report and all referenced result tables.

gaps.normative_requirement: Appliances incorporating motors are subjected to applicable motor abnormal-operation tests, including the series-motor test.
gaps.finding_reason: The component table lists a 2 000 W series motor, while the report states that there is no such motor and marks motor tests N. The tested construction cannot be reconciled.
gaps.required_action: Confirm the tested appliance’s motor configuration and provide the applicable motor-test evidence or a corrected component list.

gaps.normative_requirement: Supply-cord conductors must meet the applicable minimum cross-sectional area, and a class I cord must include the specified earthing core.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records 0.75 mm², but the component list states a two-core 0.5 mm² cord. At the declared 2 000 W and 220–240 V, the minimum applicable conductor area is 0.75 mm² even under the short portable-cord allowance; the two-core listing also conflicts with the claimed class I earthing arrangement.
gaps.required_action: Identify the actual cord and cores and demonstrate compliance or replace and retest the cord.

gaps.normative_requirement: The fryer is initially filled with unused vegetable oil, operated at the minimum indicated level, and tested until steady conditions are established.
gaps.finding_reason: The heating record refers to durations for other appliance types and does not establish the oil type, oil level, control setting or attainment of steady conditions.
gaps.required_action: Document the fryer-specific operating conditions and repeat affected tests if those conditions were not used.

gaps.normative_requirement: The fryer must be marked with minimum and maximum oil levels.
gaps.finding_reason: The report does not assess the required oil-level markings; the marking-plate copy alone does not establish whether they appear elsewhere on the appliance.
gaps.required_action: Inspect and record both oil-level markings on the tested fryer.

gaps.normative_requirement: The instructions must contain fryer-specific warnings, maximum batch load, user-maintenance instructions and the water-jet prohibition.
gaps.finding_reason: A general instruction pass refers to a product manual, but neither the manual nor an assessment of the specified fryer warnings and batch load is supplied.
gaps.required_action: Provide and assess the tested model’s complete instructions against the fryer-specific requirements.

gaps.normative_requirement: Stabilized power input at rated voltage and normal operation must remain within the applicable Table 1 deviations.
gaps.finding_reason: A pass refers to an absent table; measured power input, test voltage and deviation are unavailable.
gaps.required_action: Provide the referenced power-input measurements and applicable deviations.

gaps.normative_requirement: Heating and combined appliances normally placed on a floor or table are placed in a test corner unless a particular-part provision changes the installation.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records a floor placement but also passes a test away from the test-corner walls; the applicable fryer installation and test-corner arrangement are not established.
gaps.required_action: Document the actual installation and repeat the heating test using the applicable test-corner arrangement if necessary.

gaps.normative_requirement: Oil temperature is measured at the specified location and must not exceed 200 °C during normal heating.
gaps.finding_reason: The temperature table contains no oil-temperature result or measurement position, although the general heating result is passed.
gaps.required_action: Measure and report maximum oil temperature at the specified location under the required heating conditions.

gaps.normative_requirement: The appliance must meet applicable leakage-current and electric-strength requirements, including after humidity treatment.
gaps.finding_reason: The report claims passes but the referenced leakage-current, electric-strength and humidity tables are absent; measured currents, test voltages and humidity conditions cannot be verified.
gaps.required_action: Supply the complete test tables, conditions and results and reassess them against the applicable limits.

gaps.normative_requirement: Clearances must meet the applicable minimum values or, where permitted, withstand the impulse-voltage test.
gaps.finding_reason: The report claims passes for transient overvoltages and clearances but the referenced clearance table is absent, and no impulse-test details are supplied.
gaps.required_action: Provide the clearance measurements, applicable limits and any required impulse-test results.

gaps.normative_requirement: IPX0 through IPX4 fryers are subjected to the specified splash test for 5 min.
gaps.finding_reason: The report identifies IPX0 but marks the ingress test N and provides no fryer-specific splash-test results.
gaps.required_action: Perform and document the specified 5 min splash test and subsequent checks.

gaps.normative_requirement: Fryers must be constructed so that normal-use liquid spillage does not affect electrical insulation.
gaps.finding_reason: The spillage requirement and overfilling test are marked N without a fryer-specific justification; a separate electric-strength pass does not establish the spillage treatment.
gaps.required_action: Perform and document the applicable spillage assessment and subsequent insulation checks.

gaps.normative_requirement: The fryer is subjected to the prescribed abnormal oil conditions, and applicable oil temperatures must not exceed 230 °C.
gaps.finding_reason: The report claims abnormal-operation passes using an empty-appliance entry but does not record the two fryer-specific oil conditions or oil temperatures.
gaps.required_action: Perform and document the fryer-specific abnormal tests, including oil temperatures and ignition observations.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable class I appliances with tubular sheathed or embedded heating elements undergo the element-to-sheath fault test, subject to specified exceptions.
gaps.finding_reason: The test is marked N without identifying the heating-element construction or establishing an applicable exception.
gaps.required_action: Identify the element construction and document the test or the applicable exception.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable electronic fault conditions are evaluated and, where safety depends on a miniature fuse-link, its protection is verified.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records passes without identifying the circuits, simulated faults, measured fuse current or fuse rating; it also omits assessment of the listed partial turn-on fault condition.
gaps.required_action: Provide circuit identification, fault-by-fault results and applicable fuse-protection measurements.

gaps.normative_requirement: Thermal cut-outs protecting heating circuits must provide the specified non-self-resetting and all-pole disconnection characteristics.
gaps.finding_reason: Report clause 22.101 instead addresses fixed water boilers; it does not assess the fryer thermal-cut-out requirement.
gaps.required_action: Identify the heating-circuit protective devices and assess their construction and operation against 22.101.

gaps.normative_requirement: Red indications are restricted to danger or alarm functions, and hot-oil spillage onto parts exceeding 300 °C must be adequately prevented.
gaps.finding_reason: The report entries numbered 22.102 and 22.103 address an espresso coffee-maker and a feeding-bottle heater, not the fryer requirements.
gaps.required_action: Inspect and document the fryer’s indication colours and protection against hot-oil contact with hot parts.

gaps.normative_requirement: Heating elements must disconnect under the specified removal or swing-up conditions, and the fryer must provide the specified oil-surge allowance.
gaps.finding_reason: The report’s entries for these clause numbers concern boiling-water appliances and kettles; no fryer element-disconnection assessment or surge-volume-to-batch-load measurement is recorded.
gaps.required_action: Assess element disconnection and measure the fryer’s surge allowance against its recommended batch load.

gaps.normative_requirement: Fryer baskets and applicable movable heating elements must be safely retained in the raised position.
gaps.finding_reason: The photographed fryer includes a basket, but the report contains no assessment of its retention in the raised position.
gaps.required_action: Inspect and manually test the applicable raised-position retention.

gaps.normative_requirement: Portable appliances must prevent small items entering underside openings and reaching live parts, with the specified minimum distances.
gaps.finding_reason: The report indicates a mass below 3 kg and describes portable-appliance tests, but contains no underside-opening assessment.
gaps.required_action: Inspect underside openings and record the applicable distances to live parts.

gaps.normative_requirement: Components must meet applicable safety requirements and switches required for compliance must meet the specified cycle requirements.
gaps.finding_reason: A 250 V, 3 A switch is listed, but its circuit function, load and suitability in the appliance are not established; the report marks switch compliance N.
gaps.required_action: Identify the switch function and load and provide component approval or applicable test evidence.

gaps.normative_requirement: Fryer supply cords must be oil-resistant and at least equivalent to the specified ordinary polychloroprene-sheathed cord.
gaps.finding_reason: The report passes an ordinary PVC cord and marks the polychloroprene cord entry N; no evidence of the required oil resistance or equivalence is supplied.
gaps.required_action: Verify the installed cord against the fryer-specific oil-resistance and cord-type requirements.

gaps.normative_requirement: A type Y supply cord requires an adequate anchorage, restricted anchorage access and the specified additional insulation.
gaps.finding_reason: The report identifies type Y attachment and a supply cord but marks the anchorage, pull-and-torque test and additional insulation N without justification.
gaps.required_action: Inspect and test the actual type Y cord arrangement and record the results.

gaps.normative_requirement: Earthing connections must be secured against loosening and corrosion, and the earth conductor must remain effective if the cord slips.
gaps.finding_reason: The report declares a class I cord-connected appliance but marks these earthing assessments N without reasons.
gaps.required_action: Inspect and document the earthing terminal, corrosion protection and conductor arrangement.

gaps.normative_requirement: Earth-continuity resistance must not exceed 0.1 Ω under the specified test conditions.
gaps.finding_reason: The report claims a pass but does not record the measured resistance, test current or tested points.
gaps.required_action: Provide the earth-continuity measurements and test conditions for each relevant accessible metal part.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable screws and nuts used for electrical and earthing connections must withstand the specified mechanical test.
gaps.finding_reason: The report marks the torque test N despite claiming electrical and earthing connections; no construction-based exemption is recorded.
gaps.required_action: Identify applicable fixings and document the required torque tests or valid exemptions.

gaps.normative_requirement: The fryer microenvironment is pollution degree 3 and insulation CTI is at least 250 unless the specified protection from pollution applies.
gaps.finding_reason: The report uses an unrelated conditional pollution-degree entry and provides neither CTI evidence nor justification for a protected microenvironment.
gaps.required_action: Establish the applicable microenvironment and provide CTI or proof-tracking evidence and creepage measurements.

gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant non-metallic parts must withstand the ball-pressure test at the temperature determined from the applicable temperature rises and minimum temperatures.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records an enclosure test at 75 °C and an internal plastic-enclosure rise of 65.0 K, but does not establish which material and location were tested or the basis for the selected temperature.
gaps.required_action: Identify each tested part and substantiate the ball-pressure temperature from the relevant measured rise.

gaps.normative_requirement: The particular standard specifies a 650 °C glow-wire test under 30.2.1.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records the enclosure glow-wire test at 550 °C and passes it; this is below the specified fryer test temperature.
gaps.required_action: Test the relevant parts at 650 °C or provide evidence supporting an applicable permitted alternative.

final_summary.evaluation_conclusion: The supplied report does not demonstrate compliance of model 20 with US IEC 60335-1:2010 as modified by US IEC 60335-2-37:2002. Product non-conformity cannot be conclusively established from the conflicting component records alone, but the missing and incorrectly applied evidence blocks a certification decision.
final_summary.recommended_action: Obtain a complete, corrected laboratory report identifying the tested construction and documenting all applicable inspections and tests, including any necessary retesting, before certification proceeds.
